sn45.63:1.2: “Bhikkhus, one thing helps give rise to the noble eightfold path.
sn45.63:1.5: A bhikkhu with good friends can expect to develop and cultivate the noble eightfold path.
sn45.63:1.6: And how does a bhikkhu with good friends develop and cultivate the noble eightfold path?
sn45.63:1.7: It’s when a bhikkhu develops right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, and right concentration, which rely on seclusion, fading away, and cessation, and ripen as letting go.
sn45.63:1.8: That’s how a bhikkhu with good friends develops and cultivates the noble eightfold path.”
